jobs.description: Silver load of 법원경매정보 (root ADR-0280; the publisher's load-courtauction-go-kr-silver, DuckDB inside the publisher, for every document, root ADR-0559): the objects of each search that no commit of its table records (plan-silver-load-objects, R2 alone), oldest first, give every row its PNU through the one place-identity resolver (its legal-dong code and lot carried to the current code, else its address; root ADR-0288, ADR-0382) and appends to silver.court_auction_item the rows whose content changed and, for a complete item search, a removal marker per 물건 that left it, and to silver.court_auction_sale_result the rows whose content changed; each 물건상세 object's new photos, its changed documents (case, 매각물건명세서 summary, 기일내역, 목록내역, 제시외건물, 감정요항표; root ADR-0540) and then its reads; each 공통코드 object's codes whose name changed (silver.court_auction_code, root ADR-0540 §5); each 사건상세, 현황조사 and 감정평가 object's changed documents (the case, related cases, 목록 종국결과, 당사자 kinds; a 현황조사 round and its 목록; a 감정평가 round) and then its reads (silver.court_auction_case_document_read, root ADR-0540 §1, §3); each 문건·송달 object's filings and deliveries, a whole edition per case whose list changed, the role and kind around the name the site masks and never the name (silver.court_auction_case_filing, silver.court_auction_case_delivery, root ADR-0575 §5), and then its reads; each 감정평가서 object's stored reports (silver.court_auction_appraisal_report, the media reconcile's index) and then every request (silver.court_auction_appraisal_report_read); each 매각물건명세서 object's versions asked (silver.court_auction_sale_specification_read, root ADR-0575); then, on the two search tables, the rows a 법정동 code change since the last follow can move are placed again and those whose placement moved appended (root ADR-0329 §3, ADR-0416). 06:30 KST, after the night's collection; `unchanged` when nothing is owed.

The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.
jobs.disabled_reason: Paused for the Bronze epoch (root ADR-0626 §8 N2, W114, coordinator 2026-11-28): the reader of those sources. The job bronze_epoch moves those objects to the key today's writer builds and their ledger rows in place, and refuses while a writer of theirs has run in the last two close intervals; a run here meanwhile would split a source row or land a key of the old form. The resume pull request turns it on again (enabled true, enabled_since its merge) once the epoch's report is verified. Nothing is lost while it is off: a collector's next run asks what is due from its state and its Silver table, and a Silver load plans from the ledger what its table has not recorded. It was at dagster_stage dagster, where the resume puts it back.
